text:
jonah: Sprint 0 pen-test kickoff next Wed 14:00 PT. Need owners for: oncall rota, RBAC timeboxed roles, KMS unwrap plan, audit export TTLs, and a repro-triage board. Kickoff 2pm? :calendar:
sarah: I can own RBAC temp roles. Suggest a timeboxed 'pt-ro' with explicit Deny for write/config changes and session tagging so we can trace actions.
kevin: I'll take KMS gating and the decrypt path. Question: should assessors get direct decrypt or go through a small proxy lambda that does controlled unwraps?
elaine: For auditing, propose a near-real-time export to a dedicated S3 bucket during the window plus daily snapshot retention 90d. Need to agree TTL for short-term evidence copies.
maria: Created triage board: https://phab.redwood/internal/pt-sprint0 — please add repro steps, CVSS or severity, and attack-surface tags.
assessor-bot: Assessor queue created. Upload evidence to s3://redwood-pt-intake using presigned URLs only. No credentials in threads.
jonah: Quick RBAC example to propose for the sprint:
```json
{
  "Role": "pt-readonly",
  "Policies": ["ReadOnly","Deny:ConfigDelete"],
  "SessionDurationSeconds": 14400,
  "RequireMFA": true
}
```
kevin: Proxy approach preferred — assessors call ephemeral proxy that unwraps with limited KMS permissions. Proxy logs principal identity and request metadata. That gives us an audit trail and reduces blast radius.
elaine: Agree on proxy. Also update key policy to require an AuthorizedPrincipalTag for any Decrypt/GenerateDataKey operations.
maria: Proof-of-fix checklist (short): 1) exploit not reproducible on new build; 2) audit/logs show only expected proxy unwraps; 3) KMS usage limited to proxy principal; 4) post-fix telemetry shows no anomalous traffic.
sam: Oncall rota: I'll cover Wed 13:30–17:30 PT. @kevin will be backup. We still need a second SRE for rollback steps during the window.
ops-oncall: Rollback runbook added to Confluence /sec/pt-rollbacks. TL;DR: flip pt-ingress=false, scale down staging, snapshot evidence buckets, and isolate affected services.
devops-bot: Export task template for logs (example):
`aws logs create-export-task --log-group-name /redwood/inference --from 5043216000 --to 5043223200 --destination s3://redwood-pt-evidence`
jonah: Proposed retest slots: Thu 10:00–12:00 PT and Fri 15:00–17:00 PT. @assessor-bot can you reserve Thu?
assessor-bot: Thu slot reserved. Please attach fix PRs and patch notes to the triage card before retest.
kevin: One more KMS detail — enforce MFA on any session that can request an unwrap. Add MFA requirement to the pt-readonly role or to a bound session policy.
elaine: I'll draft the Sprint 0 playbook and upload to the triage board by EOD. We should run a small dry-run Monday with the proxy lambda and export task to validate the flow.
maria: Tagging standards: add labels 'severity', 'exploit-path', 'rollback-id', and 'proof-of-fix'. Makes retest acceptance criteria explicit. :white_check_mark:
jonah: Owners recap: RBAC = sarah; KMS/proxy = kevin; Audit exports = elaine; Triage board = maria; Oncall = sam. I'll send the calendar invite and include the runbook link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
